steps.instruction: Draw a round head with two pointy ears on top.
Draw the back curving down from the head, and the chest on the front.
Add the big round back leg, two front legs, and a flat line on the ground.
Draw a long, fluffy tail that wraps around in front of the feet.
Finish the face: almond eyes, a small triangle nose, a mouth, and whiskers.
Draw the head from the side: a round top and a long snout pointing left.
Hang a long floppy ear from the top of the head.
Draw the back and the tummy. The back is long and nearly flat.
Add four legs with little paws. The back legs bend like a zigzag.
Draw a tail that curves up, then the eye, the nose, and the mouth.
Draw a round head on the left that flows into a plump body and a long tail.
Add a short pointy beak on the front of the head.
Draw a wing on the side of the body with a pointy tip near the tail.
Draw a branch, then two thin legs with toes holding on.
Finish with a shiny eye and a little line where the beak opens.
Draw an oval body that is pointy at the tail end.
Add a tail shaped like a big V at the back.
Draw a fin on top, a small fin underneath, and one on its side.
Draw a curved gill line behind the head, a mouth, and a round eye.
Finish with a few curved scales on the body.
Draw an oval head that leans forward, with a pointy nose on the left.
Add two long ears that point up and lean back.
Draw a round back that curves down, and the chest under the head.
Add a big back leg with a long foot, a short front leg, and a fluffy tail.
Finish with an eye, a little nose, and whiskers.
Draw the long head and the neck. The face slopes down to a soft nose on the left.
Draw the back and the round rump, then the tummy line underneath.
Add four long, thin legs with hooves. The back legs bend backward in the middle.
Draw a flowing mane down the neck and a long, wavy tail.
Finish the face: an eye, a nostril, and a mouth line.
Draw a big, long body with a flat back and a square-ish rump on the right.
Draw the head on the left. It is wide at the top and has a big nose at the bottom.
Add ears that stick out sideways and two small curved horns.
Draw four short straight legs with hooves, a udder, and a thin tail with a tuft.
Finish with big spots on the body, an eye, and two nostrils.
Draw a big round body like a fat bean.
Add a short snout that ends in a flat oval nose on the left.
Draw a floppy triangle ear on the head.
Add four short legs with little hooves.
Finish with a curly tail, an eye, and a smile.
Draw a body shaped like a boat, with a pointy tail up on the right.
Draw a curved neck going up to a round head.
Add a long flat bill on the front of the head.
Draw the wing on the side with feather tips at the back.
Finish with an eye and two legs with webbed feet.
Draw a body shaped like a hill, with a bump for the eye and a pointy nose on the left.
Draw a big round eye in the bump, and a long smile from the nose.
Draw the big folded back leg like an oval on the side of the body.
Add the long back foot on the ground with spread toes, and a front leg.
Finish with a few round spots on the back.
Draw a tall rounded shell like half an egg.
Draw the pattern on the shell: a middle shape with lines going out.
Add a head on a neck sticking out of the front.
Draw two stubby front and back legs with toes, and a little pointy tail.
Finish with an eye and a smile.
Draw a thin body down the middle and a small round head on top.
Draw two big top wings that point out to the corners.
Draw two smaller round wings underneath.
Add two curly feelers with dots on the ends.
Decorate the wings with circles and lines. Make both sides match.
Draw a big rounded back and a round tummy line for the body.
Draw the head on the left with a long trunk that hangs down and curls at the end.
Add a big floppy ear on the side of the head.
Draw thick legs like tree trunks, two in front and two at the back. The far leg peeks out beside the near one. Add toenails.
Finish with an eye, a white tusk under the trunk, and a thin tail.
Draw a big fluffy mane: a bumpy circle on the left.
Draw the face inside the mane, with two small round ears on top.
Draw the long back and the tummy of the body.
Add strong legs, two in front and two at the back (the far leg peeks out), and a long tail with a fluffy tip.
Finish the face: two eyes, a wide nose, and a mouth.
Draw a body like a teardrop lying down, with the pointy nose on the left.
Add a big round ear on the head, with a smaller circle inside.
Draw small feet under the body.
Draw a long, thin tail that curves away.
Finish with a shiny eye, a nose, and whiskers.
Draw a tall egg-shaped body with two pointy ear tufts on top.
Draw a face shape like a wide heart around where the eyes go.
Add two big round eyes with dark middles, and a small beak pointing down.
Draw folded wings on both sides and little V feathers on the chest.
Finish with a branch and small curved claws holding on.
Draw a tall body like a bowling pin, with a round head on top.
Draw the white tummy shape inside, from under the beak to the feet.
Add a flipper on each side, pointing down.
Draw a pointy beak and an eye.
Finish with two flat feet at the bottom.
Draw the head from the side, with a short snout on the left and a round ear.
Draw a big hump on the shoulders, a long back, and a round rump.
Add thick legs with big paws: two at the front and two at the back. The far leg peeks out beside the near one.
Draw little claws on the front paws and a tiny tail.
Finish with an eye, a big nose, and a mouth.
Draw the head from the side: pointy ears and a long, pointy nose.
Draw a slim body: a gently curved back and the tummy.
Add slim legs with small paws, two at the front and two at the back.
Draw a big, bushy tail that sweeps out behind.
Finish with an eye, a black nose, and the white cheek line.
Draw a long body like a big raindrop lying down. Round nose on the left, thin at the tail on the right.
Add the tail fluke at the end: two pointy flaps, one up and one down.
Draw a long curved mouth line from the nose, and a few belly lines under it.
Add a long flipper under the body and a small fin on the back near the tail.
Finish with an eye just above the end of the mouth, and a splashy spout on top of the head.
Draw a long body like a torpedo, with a pointy nose on the left.
Add a tall triangle fin on the back. Its back edge curves in.
Draw a tail like a crescent moon: a big top point and a smaller bottom point.
Add a long fin under the front of the body and a small one near the tail.
Finish with an eye, a mouth, and five gill lines.
Draw a big head with a long jaw, facing left.
Draw the back going down into a long tail with a point, and the tummy underneath.
Add a huge back leg with a big thigh and a foot with claws.
Draw two tiny arms on the chest.
Finish with an eye, a nostril, and some pointy teeth.
Draw a head shaped like a rounded diamond.
Draw a long body that wiggles like an S and gets thinner to a pointy tail.
Add stripes across the body.
Finish with an eye and a forked tongue.
Draw a big oval for the back part of the body.
Draw a smaller oval on top for the front part.
Draw four legs on the left. Each leg bends up at the knee, then goes down.
Draw four matching legs on the right side.
Finish with tiny eyes, two small fangs, and a pattern on the back.
Draw a round head, then a round middle, then a big oval tail end.
Draw curved stripes across the tail end and a small stinger.
Add two see-through wings on the back, pointing up.
Draw three thin legs under the middle, bent at the knees.
Finish with a big eye and two feelers on the head.
Draw a big fluffy body: a bumpy cloud shape.
Draw the head on the left, long with a soft nose.
Add an ear that sticks out sideways and fluffy wool on top of the head.
Draw four thin legs with little hooves.
Finish with an eye, a nose, and a little tail.
Draw a wide shell, a little pointy at each side.
Draw two arms with big pincer claws on top.
Add three bent legs on each side.
Draw two eyes on short stalks.
Finish with a small mouth and a few bumps on the shell.
Draw a big round head, a little taller than it is wide.
Add two eyes low on the head.
Draw three wavy arms on the left. They get thinner and curl at the ends.
Draw three matching arms on the right.
Finish with little round suckers under the arms.
Draw a small head with a long nose, two little horns with knobs, and an ear.
Draw a very long neck going down and to the right.
Draw a short body that slopes down to the back.
Add four very long, thin legs and a tail with a tuft.
Finish with an eye and patches all over the neck and body.
Draw a round head with a round ear on each side.
Draw the face shape inside: two bumps on top for the eyes and a round muzzle.
Draw a pear-shaped body that is sitting down.
Add long arms resting on the knees, and bent legs with feet.
Finish with eyes, a nose, a big smile, and a long curly tail.
Draw the head facing left, with a long snout, and two horns curving back.
Draw a long neck down to the body, then a long tail with a pointy end.
Draw a big bat wing on the back. The bottom edge has curvy points.
Add a front leg and a big strong back leg, both with claws.
Finish with an eye, a nostril, and little spikes down the neck and back.
Draw the long head and the neck. The face slopes down to a soft nose on the left.
Draw the back and the round rump, then the tummy line underneath.
Add four long, thin legs with hooves. The back legs bend backward in the middle.
Draw a flowing mane down the neck and a long, wavy tail.
Add a long pointy horn on the forehead with a spiral, then an eye and a nostril.
Draw the base band.
Add three tall points.
Put a circle jewel on each point and on the band.
Draw a long thin stick, tilted a little.
Add a star at the tip.
Draw two smaller sparkle stars.
Add two bands on the handle.
Draw the side of the car: a low trunk, a curved roof, and a long hood. Leave round bumps for the wheels.
Draw two wheels in the bumps, each with a small circle in the middle.
Add two side windows under the roof.
Draw the door lines, door handles, a headlight, and a taillight.
Finish with a road line under the wheels.
Draw a long rounded rectangle for the bus.
Add a row of square windows.
Draw two wheels.
Add a door and two headlights.
Draw the cab on the left. A rounded square is fine.
Add the long cargo box on the right.
Draw three wheels.
Add a window on the cab and a headlight.
Draw the engine body, a long rounded rectangle.
Add the cabin, a taller rectangle at the back.
Draw a chimney and three smoke puffs.
Add three wheels and a triangle cowcatcher on the front.
Draw a window on the cabin.
Draw a long tube for the body with a round nose on the right. It gets thinner and turns up at the tail.
Draw the big wing sweeping back under the body, and the far wing peeking over the top.
Add a tall fin on the tail and a small flat wing beside it.
Hang a round engine under the wing.
Finish with the cockpit window at the front and a row of little windows.
Draw the hull. It is a trapezoid, wider at the top.
Add a straight mast.
Draw a triangle sail.
Add a flag, a porthole, and two wave lines.
Draw two big wheels side by side, each with a tiny circle in the middle.
Draw the frame: two triangles that share the line under the seat.
Add the front fork down to the wheel, and handlebars on top.
Draw the seat on a short post, and the pedals in the middle.
Finish with thin spokes in both wheels.
Draw a round cabin, like a big egg lying on its side, with the front on the left.
Draw a long, thin tail going out to the right, with a small fin at the end.
Draw a big window at the front and a door line.
Add a short post on top and long, thin spinning blades.
Finish with two legs and a long skid to land on.
Draw the apple: two round bumps on top with a dip in the middle, and a rounded bottom.
Add a short stem coming out of the dip.
Draw a leaf next to the stem, with a line down its middle.
Finish with a curved shine line on the left side.
Draw a long curved shape like a smile turned on its side, pointy at the bottom left.
Add a short stem at the top with a flat end.
Draw a line along the banana to show its edge.
Finish with a dark tip at the bottom.
Draw a big slice: a point at the bottom and a curved edge at the top.
Draw a second curve under the top to make the thick crust.
Add round pepperoni slices.
Finish with little olive rings and bits of green pepper.
Draw a cone: a long triangle with the point at the bottom.
Draw criss-cross lines on the cone, like a waffle.
Draw a big round scoop on top with drips around the bottom.
Finish with a cherry and a little stem on top.
Draw a wide oval for the top of the cake.
Draw the sides going down and a curved bottom.
Add drippy frosting under the top edge, and a curved line for the filling.
Draw three thin candles on top.
Finish with a little flame on each candle.
Draw a circle.
Add chocolate chips. Small circles scattered on the cookie.
Draw a little bite on the upper right: a small curve cutting the edge.
Draw a long carrot shape: wide and round at the top, and pointy at the bottom.
Add short curved lines across the carrot.
Draw three long, leafy stems sticking out of the top.
Finish with a line down the middle of each leaf.
Draw the wrapper. It is a trapezoid, wider at the top.
Add pleat lines on the wrapper.
Swirl a round frosting cloud on top.
Add a cherry.
Draw a big half circle: a flat line on top and a round bottom.
Draw a second curve inside to make the green skin.
Add a third curve close to the skin for the white part.
Finish with seeds shaped like little teardrops.
Draw a big circle.
Draw a smaller circle in the middle for the hole.
Add sprinkle marks around the ring.
Draw a berry that is wide at the top and comes to a round point at the bottom.
Draw a leafy cap with pointy leaves on top.
Add a short stem.
Finish with lots of tiny seeds.
Draw a long sausage with round ends.
Draw the back of the bun peeking up behind the sausage.
Draw the front of the bun: a big curve under the sausage.
Finish with a wiggly line of mustard along the top.
Draw a thick trunk that spreads out into roots at the bottom.
Draw a big, bumpy cloud of leaves on top of the trunk.
Add branches growing up from the trunk into the leaves.
Finish with bark lines on the trunk and a line for the ground.
Draw a circle for the middle of the flower.
Draw long, thin petals all the way around, like the spokes of a wheel.
Draw a long stem that bends a little on the way down.
Add two pointy leaves on the stem.
Finish with little dots in the middle.
Draw a circle for the face.
Add rays all the way around. Straight lines are perfect.
Draw two eyes and a smile.
Draw one cloud outline: three bumps on top and a smooth bottom.
Add two eyes.
Draw a smile.
Add a short shine curve on the left bump.
Draw a big arch.
Draw a second arch inside the first.
Draw a third, smaller arch.
Add a small cloud at each end.
Draw a big triangle.
Add a smaller triangle beside it.
Cap the tall peak with a snow zigzag.
Put a small sun in the corner.
Draw a pointed leaf outline.
Add the center vein, from the stem to the tip.
Draw a short stem.
Add side veins.
Draw a round cap like a dome, with a gently curved bottom edge.
Draw a thick stem that gets a little wider at the bottom.
Add thin lines under the cap for the gills.
Finish with round spots on the cap and a few blades of grass.
Stack three circles, biggest at the bottom.
Add a top hat.
Draw eyes, a carrot nose, a smile, and buttons.
Add stick arms.
Draw one cloud at the top of the page.
Add raindrops underneath. Straight lines are easy to copy.
Add shorter drops between the long ones.
Draw a puddle at the bottom.
Draw the rocket body, a tall rounded rectangle.
Add a triangle nose.
Draw a round window.
Add a fin on each side.
Draw the flame underneath.
Draw a circle.
Add a wide ring around it. A flat oval works.
Draw a few crater circles on the planet.
Draw a five-point star.
Add two eyes and a smile in the middle.
Draw two tiny stars nearby.
Draw the crescent outline.
Add a sleepy face: two closed eyes and a small smile.
Sprinkle three tiny stars around the moon.
Draw a big oval head.
Add two large oval eyes.
Draw antennae with little balls on the ends.
Add a small body, two arms, and a smile.
Draw a big round helmet with a wide window in the front.
Draw a puffy suit body under the helmet.
Add two puffy arms with round gloves.
Draw two legs with big boots.
Finish with a control box on the chest and a shine on the helmet window.
Draw a square for the walls.
Add a triangle roof.
Draw a door.
Add a window with a cross.
Draw a chimney, a doorknob, and two smoke puffs.
Draw the main wall.
Add three towers. Make the middle one taller.
Draw battlements: small squares along the tops.
Add an arched door and two windows.
Put a triangle flag on the middle tower.
Draw a wide rectangle for the building.
Add a small bell tower on the roof.
Draw the door.
Add a grid of windows.
Draw two steps.
Draw the barn walls.
Add a gambrel roof: a house roof with an extra bend.
Draw the big door with an X.
Add a silo beside the barn.
Draw a small window in the roof.
Draw the tower, wider at the bottom.
Add stripe lines.
Draw the lantern room and a dome.
Add light rays and a door.
Draw rocks at the base.
Draw the road of the bridge: two long lines across the page.
Draw two tall towers, each with two cross bars.
Draw the big cable: it swoops down between the towers like a smile.
Add thin straight lines from the cable down to the road.
Finish with wavy water under the bridge.
Draw a big circle.
Draw a five-sided shape in the middle and color it in.
Draw lines from each corner out toward the edge, splitting into a Y.
Color in the patches near the edge, between the Y lines.
Draw the open cover: two pages with a curved bottom.
Add the spine in the middle.
Draw writing lines on each page.
Add a bookmark ribbon.
Draw a wide oval for the top of the mug.
Draw the sides going down and a round bottom.
Add a big curved handle on the right.
Finish with a line for the drink inside, and wavy steam on top.
Draw a circle.
Add tick marks at the top, bottom, left, and right.
Draw the hands. The short hand points right. The long hand points up.
Add two bells and little feet to make an alarm clock.
Draw the brim, a wide flat oval.
Add the crown, a tall rectangle.
Draw the top of the hat, a smaller oval.
Add a band around the crown.
Draw a big dome for the top of the umbrella.
Draw the bottom edge as four curved bumps.
Draw curved lines from the top down to each point.
Finish with a long handle that curls at the bottom like a J, and a tip on top.
Draw the long body.
Add the wood tip, a triangle, and a lead point.
Draw the eraser and the metal band.
Add a line where the wood meets the body.
Draw a diamond.
Add the cross spars.
Draw a tail with two bows.
Draw an oval balloon.
Add the knot, a small triangle.
Draw a curly string.
Add a shine curve on the balloon.
Draw a big heart: two bumps on top and a point at the bottom.
Draw a smaller heart inside.
Add two little sparkle stars.
Draw the box.
Add the lid line.
Draw the ribbon, one line down and one across.
Add a bow on top: two loops and two tails.
Draw a rounded square head.
Draw a bigger rounded body.
Add eyes, a smile, and an antenna.
Draw arms and legs.
Add a chest panel.
Draw the seat as a slanted box shape, like you are looking from the side.
Draw two tall posts going up from the back of the seat.
Add a curved bar across the top and two slats under it.
Draw four legs. The back legs are a little shorter because they are farther away.
Draw the base, a flat oval.
Add the stem.
Draw the lampshade, a trapezoid wider at the bottom.
Add a pull cord and two light lines.
